function: Weak insecticidal toxin with probable ion channel impairing activity. In vivo, induces paralysis when injected into sheep blowflies (L.cuprina). Shows weak toxicity, since it is only toxic at high doses, and flies recover within 24 hours.
similarity: Belongs to the neurotoxin 25 family. F7 subfamily.
